svg.title: Hybrid attention stack with sparse experts, illustrative cover
svg.desc: Abstract illustration: a column of 93 layers in two colours (69 linear-attention KDA layers and 24 sparse-attention DSA layers) feeding a grid of experts where 16 routed plus 2 shared experts light up, above a band reading 2.8T total parameters, 104B active, 1M context, open weights. Not an official Moonshot AI image.

g.text: 16 routed + 2 shared experts per token (of 896; grid is schematic)
